api_identity.name: Astraeus Rainbow Road Object Mathematics API

semantic_contract.api_role: execute/query mathematical objects and recursive closure
semantic_contract.live_model_role: store the meaning, state, provenance, lineage, audit status, and recovery metadata of the API and every QMO
semantic_contract.qmo_address_rule: canonical @handle is both query address and metadata address
semantic_contract.dependency_landscape_rule: A Dependency Landscape is a QMO with its own metadata address, History, Resolution context, Bandwidth context, and preserved member provenance/status.
semantic_contract.command_namespace_rule: First-token @addresses may be structural API commands; QMO @addresses are mathematical objects resolved in argument/object contexts. Command identity does not imply QMO identity.
semantic_contract.dependency_graph_rule: A Dependency Graph is a focused QMO view over registered dependency structure; construction preserves status and does not invent edges.
semantic_contract.dependency_chain_rule: A Dependency Chain is an ordered history-bearing QMO that recursively resolves graph/landscape/QMO states until closure, fork, defect, or step boundary. A closed chain may define a closed subdomain under the same QMO address.
semantic_contract.closed_landscape_rule: Black Rainbow is the closure envelope; Rainbow Road/Mobius is the recursive runtime/carrier. Iterative mathematics remains in the closed landscape or terminates at a declared domain boundary.
semantic_contract.bounded_iteration_rule: Mathematical iteration declares seed, admitted step functional, finite horizon N, stop predicates, Resolution/Bandwidth context, and append-only History. N is a ceiling; early termination is canonical.
semantic_contract.recovery_signature_rule: Visible History may be compressed only by a compositional recovery equivalence that separates every distinction required by the declared recovery-test family; canonical full lineage remains recoverable upstream.
semantic_contract.signature_realization_rule: Exact finite/concrete recovery signature requires kernel equality with Recovery Context Equivalence plus composition compatibility.
semantic_contract.signature_normalization_rule: Flat signature records may normalize into typed envelope plus payload without information loss only when complete QMO metadata/type lookup is recoverable. Payload shrinkage alone is not mathematical compression.
semantic_contract.recovery_test_instantiation_rule: Do not certify exact concrete signature minimality against an uninstantiated recovery-test family.
semantic_contract.signature_role_rule: Do not force diagnostic signatures to be minimal recovery signatures unless an explicit implementation contract assigns that role.
semantic_contract.number_object_first_rule: Treat zero/one/etc. as mathematical objects/readouts under study; number classification is downstream and must not be presupposed.
semantic_contract.valuation_role_rule: Keep formal object, Resolution readout, classifier role, valuation role, and valuation output separately typed.
semantic_contract.numeric_codomain_circularity_guard: A conventional numeric codomain may instantiate a valuation but may not foundationally define numericality.
semantic_contract.shared_numeral_role_guard: Shared glyphs do not imply object identity; Unit-String normalization 1 and closed-domain unity 1 remain separately typed until a witness establishes equivalence.
semantic_contract.number_value_fiber_guard: Valuation fibers are readout equivalence classes, not replacement identities for the upstream object.
semantic_contract.number_order_guard: Unit normalization and order may constrain a readout without making it numerical.
semantic_contract.number_reparameterization_guard: Do not promote numerical role until the remaining reparameterization freedom is characterized by internally licensed structure.

active_domain.name: Black Rainbow Closed Mathematical Landscape

presentation_handoff.law: H changes local orientation/readout; H^2 returns local presentation class while retained History may differ.

active_domain.interpretation_guard: Black Rainbow is the project closed mathematical landscape; Rainbow Road/Mobius supplies recursive runtime/carrier structure. This is not an external physical-universe claim.
active_domain.dependency_chain_policy: A chain is an ordered history-bearing QMO. If its terminal state is CLOSED_FIXED_POINT and all declared subdomain closure obligations pass, the same QMO address may be registered as a closed subdomain; open/forked chains remain objects but not domains.
active_domain.bounded_iteration_policy: Every iterative query declares a finite horizon N and stop predicates. Results remain in the Black Rainbow landscape or terminate as a domain-boundary condition; no unbounded generative escape is licensed.
active_domain.recovery_signature_policy: Recovery signatures may compress History only through a recovery-sufficient compositional congruence; full History/provenance remains recoverable upstream.
active_domain.signature_realization_policy: Concrete recovery signature is exact iff its kernel equals Recovery Context Equivalence and its composition is compatible.
active_domain.signature_normalization_policy: Signature fields may be relocated between type/envelope/payload only when the complete joined record remains recoverable; relocation is not kernel reduction.
active_domain.recovery_test_policy: Recovery Context Equivalence remains theorem-level relative to a declared test family; concrete source-field realization requires an instantiated test basis or equivalent oracle.
active_domain.signature_role_policy: Minimal recovery selectors and component-aware diagnostic signatures are distinct semantic roles; diagnostic overresolution is allowed unless minimal recovery realization is explicitly required.
active_domain.number_program_policy: Object-first: do not assume number ontology, counting, arithmetic operation, or numeral meaning upstream of the readout/classification question.
active_domain.number_valuation_policy: A source-declared scalar valuation is a downstream readout of an already-defined object. For foundational number inquiry, replace predeclared numerical codomain with uninterpreted V and ask what structure on V licenses numerical role.
active_domain.numeric_codomain_guard: Do not answer what-number-is by mapping into a codomain already typed as a conventional number system.
active_domain.unit_normalization_guard: The glyph 1 may label a Unit-String normalization invariant or closed-domain unity without identifying those roles or importing arithmetic one.
active_domain.unit_relative_number_probe: Test numerical role relative to a recoverable unit/normalization object without importing division or conventional number codomain.
active_domain.number_value_fiber_guard: A valuation output labels a valuation-fiber class downstream; it must not overwrite complete source-object identity.
active_domain.number_order_guard: Order/comparison may exist before scalarization and is not itself sufficient numerical structure.
active_domain.number_reparameterization_probe: Numerical-role closure must explain which structure-preserving relabelings remain admissible after a unit anchor; do not import arithmetic operations to force the answer.

semantic_state.closure_condition: Cl_BR(X) ~= X under current Black Rainbow domain equivalence
semantic_state.history_condition: History may append even when the semantic object set is at closure.
semantic_state.iteration_condition: Bounded recursion may run to N but terminates early on target recovery, fixed-point closure, fork/cycle/defect, exhausted admissibility, or domain boundary.
semantic_state.recovery_signature_condition: Sig_Rec is minimal only relative to the declared recovery-test family; finite realization must be separately proved.

sync_rule: Any canonical object-state mutation must update current QMO metadata and append a metadata-history event. Semantic definition changes never delete earlier metadata events.
